newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AmEx price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AmEx price target raised.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said on Tuesday it raised its 18-month price target on the shares of American Express Co to $100 per share from $70 per share and reiterated its strong buy on the stock.

-- Analyst Jennifer Oliver Martin said that, based on a series of conversations with senior management at American Express, she believed the company was very capable of achieving a 15 percent earnings growth rate and 15 to 18 percent return-on-equity.
-- "We are more comfortable with these targets than we were before," she said. "They are easily achievable targets."
-- Martin said American Express had a number of projects underway to ensure business would grow, and its core businesses were also successful.
-- American Express shares were up 2-5/8 at 77-7/8.
